title: Notes App
description: Build a notes app with add, delete, edit, and render functionality.

steps.title: Note data structure
steps.description: Create a note object template with `id`, `title`, `content`, and `date` (ISO string) properties. Also create an initial `notes` array with at least 2 sample notes.
hints: Use Date.now() or Date.now().toString() for unique ids

codeTemplate.python:
from datetime import datetime

notes = [
    # Your code here - at least 2 notes
]
import json
print(json.dumps(notes))

verification.failureMessage: Include id, title, content, and date for at least 2 notes.

steps.title: addNote function
steps.description: Write `addNote(title, content)` that creates a new note object, pushes it into the notes array, and logs `'Added: [title]'`.
hints: Generate a unique id using Date.now()
Push the new note to the array

steps.title: deleteNote function
steps.description: Write `deleteNote(id)` that removes a note by its `id` and logs `'Deleted note [id]'`.
hints: Use .filter() to create a new array without the matching note

verification.failureMessage: Remove the note with the matching id from the array.

steps.title: editNote function
steps.description: Write `editNote(id, updates)` that finds a note by id and updates its properties. The `updates` object can contain `title` and/or `content`. Update the date too. Log `'Updated: [title]'`.
hints: Update the date to the current ISO string

verification.failureMessage: Update the note with matching id using the updates object.

steps.title: renderNotes function
steps.description: Write `renderNotes(notes)` that returns a formatted HTML string displaying all notes with their title, content preview, and date.
hints: Map each note to a div or card element
Truncate content to 50 chars as a preview
Show date in a readable format

verification.failureMessage: Return HTML string with all notes displayed.
